tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The page ground. Dark is the brand's home; light (paper) is for documents, print and bright contexts.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and inputs sitting on void.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, hover fills and app-icon tiles: one step above surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, selects, checkboxes, secondary buttons, badges) and the lockup divider. Measured 3.1:1 or better against void and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, the wordmark and the primary button fill. On void, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy and secondary text on void, surface and surface-raised (8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders, metadata and mono labels. Passes 4.5:1 on void and surface; keep it for short text.

tokens.name: metal-hi
tokens.usage: Highlight stop of the silver-vinyl gradient on the mark. Not for text.

tokens.name: metal-lo
tokens.usage: Shadow stop of the silver-vinyl gradient on the mark. Not for text.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Prism hue 1 and the Studio colour. As text or a fill on void and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Prism hue 2. Appears only inside the prism line and as the success signal; never a sub-brand colour.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Prism hue 3, the Products colour and the focus ring. As text or a fill on void and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Prism hue 4 and the Labs colour. As text or a fill on void and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: products
tokens.usage: Aelnir Products: its own apps, ERP and SaaS. The line of light on the Products mark, badges and card dots.

tokens.name: studio
tokens.usage: Aelnir Studio: client work. The line of light on the Studio mark, badges and card dots.

tokens.name: labs
tokens.usage: Aelnir Labs: experiments. The line of light on the Labs mark, badges and card dots.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ember, ice or violet fill. Never use white on a dark-theme neon.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive state: saved, live, passed.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution state. Text or icon on void and surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Pinker than ember on purpose, so an error never reads as Studio.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus colour, used through the focus-ring shadow.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed layer behind a modal dialog.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Jost Light at large sizes. Headlines are short, sentence case, and never bold.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page at most: hero statements.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Jost Regular for interface text, Light for long reading at 19px.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We build software: our own products, and yours.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and marketing body copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every release ships with its tests.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Small buttons, navigation links, table cells, dense UI.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field hints and errors, footnotes, legal lines. Never for body copy.

styles.name: sub-brand
styles.usage: The arm name beside the wordmark in sub-brand lockups. Always uppercase.

groups.name: Technical
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono: anything that should read as engineered.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, badges, field labels and spec captions. Always uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, commands, hex values and version tags.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Most layouts use space-4, space-6 and space-8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, badge dot gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; label to input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small-button and input side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related items; medium-button padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between groups; large-button padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; logo clear space at the 96px mark size.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop; between major sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large marketing breaks.

radius.note: Precise, not soft. Controls are nearly square; only badges and the mark are round.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bands, tables, images.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, focus outlines on dense controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App-icon tiles (230 on a 1024 icon).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges and avatar circles.

shadow.note: Dark surfaces separate by tone and hairline, not drop shadow. Glows are light, used once per view.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: glow-ice
tokens.usage: A single highlighted Products element on dark. No glow on light.

tokens.name: glow-prism
tokens.usage: Under the prism line or the primary button on dark only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Every keyboard-focusable element: a ground-coloured gap, then a 2px ice ring.

gradient.note: The prism is the only gradient in the system.

tokens.name: prism-line
tokens.usage: The master brand's line of light on dark grounds: dividers, the primary button's base, the mark.

tokens.name: prism-line-deep
tokens.usage: The same prism on light grounds.

size.note: Fixed sizes for the logo and controls.

tokens.name: size-mark-min
tokens.usage: Smallest the mark may appear, using the small-size master. Favicons only.

tokens.name: size-mark-sm
tokens.usage: Small-size master, flat fill, no line. Navigation bars.

tokens.name: size-mark-md
tokens.usage: From here up the mark shows its metal finish and line of light.

tokens.name: size-mark-lg
tokens.usage: Hero and cover use.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small button and input height.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Large button height; minimum touch target.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Interface icons, 1.5px stroke.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: Badge height.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Status and arm dots in badges, cards and alerts; the select chevron.

tokens.name: size-check
tokens.usage: Checkbox square.

tokens.name: size-dialog
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a modal dialog.

tokens.name: size-text
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text (about 70 characters).

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Maximum page content width.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and divider: cards, inputs, buttons, badges, the prism line.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Selected tab and current navigation underline, checkmarks, spinners.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and fields.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The site header.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal dialog and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
